newsitem.title: UK: Steady Panamaxes aid six point rise in the BFI.
newsitem.headline: Steady Panamaxes aid six point rise in the BFI.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up six points on Wednesday at 1,440 points and brokers reported continuing steady conditions for Panamaxes in all areas with Far Eastern charterers working period business up to the end of this year.
More activity has also been reported in the Caper market and firmer rates were being offered by grain charterers from East Coast South America.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 10 points higher to four points lower and turnover was a small 11 lots.
